summary: Validated the new School Portal + Child Support Team end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend: all 4 new tests in test_school_portal.py pass (teacher/teacherb school isolation, scoped bundle & family video privacy, observation->guidance task + proposal/parent contributions + stale-version 409 + teacher 403 on goal PATCH, parent withdrawal cancels notifications and blocks teacher 404, admin transfer ends school A access + preserves observations). Existing suites: test_home_plans.py (all pass), test_stage_a_core_flows.py (5/6 pass), test_practice_videos.py (1/4 pass - 3 failures are ENV-related, see below). Frontend: teacher dashboard renders with school-stat-0..3 + class filter + goals/feedback/meetings; team-tab-plan/profile/activities/observations/messages/meetings all present; observation form with needs_guidance + guidance_question submits and shows 'A follow-up task was assigned to the therapist' toast; message-send is disabled until message-confirm-recipients is clicked (verified). Parent sharing page shows the Sunrise/Aarav link with scope chips, Change/Withdraw actions, professionals-with-access list, consent history and consent register; sidebar-sharing + sidebar-team visible. Parent support team renders versioned goal cards with HOME/SCHOOL/THERAPY columns and contribution form. Admin schools page shows directory with verified/active status, Invite coordinator, Suspend, Add school form, Request link and School transfer sections; sidebar-schools, sidebar-accounts, sidebar-team all present. /accept-invite?token=... renders the invitation form (invalid-token toast expected). Mobile 390px for teacher dashboard and team space has no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: test_demo_role_switch_revokes_previous_session fails - after switching persona the previous session cookie is still accepted by /api/auth/me (expected 401, got 200). start_session() does not delete the caller's prior session row, so the old mnc_session remains valid until it expires. Appears pre-existing but is a real security hygiene issue.

3 practice-video regression tests fail (upload_workspace_scoping_and_viewed_idempotency, media_access_is_authenticated_and_child_scoped, public_media_allows_configured_paths_and_rejects_guessed_private_paths). Root cause is environment-level: /usr/bin/clamscan returns exit 2 ('No supported database files found in /var/lib/clamav') so validate_and_normalize_image / media validators raise RuntimeError('Malware scanner is unavailable.') and the endpoint returns 422. Backend code is correct; the preview container has no ClamAV virus DB loaded. Not caused by the School Portal change.

action_items: Consider revoking the caller's previous session rows inside start_session() (or at least on /auth/demo persona switch) so stale cookies cannot access /auth/me after a role swap. This also makes test_stage_a_core_flows.py::test_demo_role_switch_revokes_previous_session pass.

Preview container is missing ClamAV virus signatures (/var/lib/clamav empty) which breaks every image/video upload path (admin media, practice videos). Either run `freshclam` as part of the image, or gate scan_path() so it degrades gracefully when the DB is absent (e.g. log + skip in demo mode) - the three practice-video regression tests will then pass again.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/team.py is 470 lines and getting wide; still readable but close to the 700-line split threshold - watch growth.
backend/auth.py start_session() does not invalidate caller's previous session cookie on login/demo switch; recommended for security and to fix the regression test.

scan_path() in media_processing.py returns a RuntimeError that bubbles up and is caught as 422 by the admin.py handler; message to the user is 'Please upload a valid image.' only for ValueError. When scanner is unavailable the user sees a 422 with no actionable copy - consider surfacing a 503 or a clearer admin-side message.

success_rate.backend: 81% (22/27 - all 4 new school portal tests + all home plan tests pass; 3 practice-video failures are ENV, 1 session-revoke failure is pre-existing)

test_credentials: Passwordless demo via POST /api/auth/demo {role: parent|staff|admin|school|teacher|teacherb}. Reuse the mnc_demo cookie to share the sandbox org across personas. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is still empty - may want to document the demo persona list there.
seed_data_creation: No new seed written manually; relied on seed_demo+seed_school which was already triggered during persona login. Only an extra classroom observation + a team message were posted against demo-aarav as part of the UI validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_school_portal.py is the authoritative regression for the School Portal. Each test shares one sandbox by copying the mnc_demo cookie; the withdrawal/transfer test is destructive so run it last or in a fresh cookie if you need the demo link active. ClamAV DB is missing in the preview container, so any multipart upload (admin media, practice video, document upload) will 422 with 'Malware scanner is unavailable.' until that is fixed - do not interpret those failures as app bugs. For UI tests, log out via `page.context.clear_cookies()` before switching persona because the auth pages redirect you to the current portal once a cookie is present. Teacher dashboard = /portal/school/today, team space = /portal/school/team?child=demo-aarav&tab=<plan|profile|activities|observations|messages|meetings>.
